name: i-mobyl, stock of September 2026
notes: The stock: what a new photo's list starts with, and how its stickers and pens look. Colour examples are in the pipeline's corrected Lab space (OpenCV scale, L/a/b 0-255), measured on the 2026-09-24 capture of map 2 (the pale pink on map 1 sheet 1 and the 2026-09-16 capture: two pink stocks are in use). A new colour or pen needs no change here: name it on a photo in the page and click one of its stickers or lines (the eyedropper); that look is kept with the sheet. 'label' is the name the page and the GeoJSON use. What a sticker means stays on the printed legend.

stickers.sizesNote: Circumscribed diameter of the sharp-cornered template; the die-cut corners are rounded, so the visible sticker is smaller (triangles ~15 mm, stars ~21 mm tip to tip). The search tries 0.9-1.15x these.
stickers.coloursNote: Gold only comes as stars and stars only come in gold (the classes below say so), so a star's colour is never measured and gold is never offered for circles or triangles. The gold examples are foil photographed bright (map 1 sheets 1 and 5) down to dull (sheets 2-4); they only decide where a star may be fitted. A photo whose list has one colour only for a shape treats that shape the same way.

pensNote: Route-core colours measured on the 2026-09-24 capture (red) and the 2026-09-16 capture (red, and the navy pen that photographs as neutral dark grey, L ~97). Faint light-grey lines (L 170-190) are misprint ghosts of street edges, not the blue pen.
